disposition_reason: ICP-MS concentrations of Pb, Cd, Hg and As in 70 marketed vegetables and 8 fruits from Shandong are printed by vegetable class and for fruit.

study.design: market basket survey with dietary exposure and hazard quotient assessment
study.market: local markets and retail stores in Shandong Province, China
study.period_text: Samples were taken between June and September in 2019
study.method: ICP-MS (Thermo iCAP Q) after high-pressure HNO3/H2O2 digestion of homogenized samples, internal standard quantification
study.qa: Spike recoveries 93.3-99.8% at 50 and 500 µg/kg (Hg 5 and 50 µg/kg), intra-RSD 2.55-5.36%, inter-RSD 2.16-6.61%; no CRM reported

unresolved: Basis (fresh vs dry) not stated; samples were homogenized and digested without a stated drying step.
Group means appear to be over detected samples only, not over all n; the paper does not say how non-detects were handled.
Table 2 says fruit n = 8 but only seven fruit types are listed; per-sample results for most foods are not printed.
Text pooled vegetable mercury mean 7.79 µg/kg is hard to reconcile with subgroup means 9.11, 13.20 and 5.55 µg/kg; recorded as printed.
Arsenic species not determined; As recorded as total arsenic.
